recipe.serve_and_store: Divide the finished meal evenly between two people. Refrigerate perishable leftovers in shallow covered containers at 40 F (4 C) or colder within 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90 F (32 C). Reheat leftovers to 165 F (74 C). steps.instruction: Put long-grain white rice, water for cooking starch in the lidded saucepan. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook on low for about 15-20 minutes until the rice is tender and water is absorbed. Turn off and rest covered 5 minutes. Cook the filling on the second burner while the rice cooks. Use the stated dry rice weight, not a cooked-weight substitution.

Beat whole egg with garlic powder, table salt in the raw-egg mixing bowl. Heat the allocated olive oil in the skillet over medium-low heat. Pour every portion of beaten egg into the skillet. Gently fold for about 3-5 minutes until firm curds form, no liquid egg remains and the center reaches 160 F (71 C). Transfer every cooked piece and its measured pan juices to the clean heatproof filling bowl. Keep this bowl separate from raw-food utensils.

Return all cooked whole egg from the clean heatproof filling bowl to the skillet. Take the skillet off the heat and let bubbling stop. Fold in all ready-made Dijon mustard, honey. Serve all cooked rice with the complete filling and sauce, divided into two portions.

recipe.timing_note: 20-40 minutes elapsed, 15-25 minutes active, an untested estimate; cooking endpoints control doneness.
recipe.title: Honey mustard egg and rice

steps.instruction: Use only the reserved bread amount shown below. Before handling raw egg, put bread flat in the clean, cool skillet, in fitting batches without overlap. Turn heat to low or medium-low. Toast dry; turn with the spatula when the underside is lightly golden and crisp. Toast the second side to the same cue. Watch continuously; reduce or turn off heat if browning too fast or smoking. Move each batch to clean serving plates. Add no oil, butter or toppings, and do not leave the empty nonstick pan heating between batches. Follow the pan's care instructions; if dry-food cooking is prohibited, this route is unavailable.

Turn off the burner. Use the spatula to clear loose bread crumbs onto the toast plates; let the pan cool enough that the measured oil will not smoke. Add only the oil allocated below, then return to low heat. Keep toast and clean plates separate from raw-egg utensils.

Whisk the allocated egg and salt in the raw-egg bowl. Pour into the oiled skillet on low to medium-low heat. Gently fold until firm with no liquid egg and160F(71C) in the center. Fold in all allocated cheese near the end. Turn off heat. Serve all cooked egg, cheese, measured pan oil and reserved toast for this assignment; do not make the original full batch unless its full quantity is reserved.
